name: EmptyDaySeedSelector
tests:
Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue, some empty days → no placements
Plan_NoEmptyDays_YieldsNothing: fillable has no completely empty days (every day has at least one occupied slot in 1..slotCount) → no placements
Plan_SingleEmptyDay_SingleSubject_PlacesOneLesson: one empty day, queue has 1 lesson → places that lesson in slot 1 of that day
Plan_MultipleEmptyDays_FewerSubjects_StopsWhenQueueExhausted: 3 empty days but only 2 lessons in queue → only 2 placements, 3rd empty day untouched
Plan_MultipleEmptyDays_MoreSubjects_OnlyEmptyDaysSeeded: 2 empty days, queue has 4 lessons → only 2 placements (one per empty day)
Plan_MultipleEmptyDays_MultipleSubjects_RoundRobinPick: several empty days, multiple subjects → subject order follows RoundRobinPicker over queue keys
Plan_DaysWithOccupiedSlots_OnlyEmptyDaysSelected: mix of empty days and days with some occupied slots → only fully empty days receive seeds
Plan_CustomSlotCount_Respected: slotCount=8 makes a day with slots 1-6 all free still empty if slotCount=8 but slots 7-8 not in fillable → day considered non-empty because implied occupied

name: FairShareSelector
tests:
Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue → no placements
Plan_SingleSubject_AlwaysPicked: one subject with count N → all N placements pick that subject
Plan_TwoSubjectsEqualProportions_Alternates: 50/50 split (Math=2, Physics=2) → alternates Math, Physics, Math, Physics maintaining exact proportions
Plan_TwoSubjectsUnequalProportions_MaintainsRatio: 2:1 ratio (Math=4, Physics=2) → picks in pattern that keeps squared deviation minimized, verifying fairness
Plan_ThreeSubjects_VaryingProportions_FairDistribution: Math=3, Physics=2, Chem=1 → verify order follows fairness (closest to desired proportions at each step)
Plan_QueueTotalZero_DesiredAllZero_Works: queue values sum to 0 (all zeros) → CaptureDesired produces all-zero proportions, should run without exception

name: RandomSelector
tests:
Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue → no placements
Plan_SingleSubject_AlwaysPicked: one subject with count N → all N placements pick that same subject
Plan_MultipleSubjects_SeededRandom_Deterministic: multiple subjects, seeded Random(42) → same sequence every time
Plan_MultipleSubjects_SeededRandom_Distribution: multiple subjects with equal counts, seeded Random → basic verification that output falls within expected range
Plan_QueueExhausted_Stops: queue has subjects but fewer slots than total queue count → Plan stops when slots exhausted, checks partial placement

name: RoundRobinSelector
tests:
Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue → no placements
Plan_SingleSubject_AlwaysPicked: one subject with count N → all N placements pick that subject
Plan_MultipleSubjects_EqualCounts_CyclesInOrder: Math=3, Physics=3, Chem=3 → cycles Math→Physics→Chem→Math→Physics→Chem→... with exact order matching Queue.Keys
Plan_MultipleSubjects_UnequalCounts_CyclesSkippingExhausted: Math=1, Physics=3, Chem=1 → after Math and Chem exhaust, Physics takes remaining slots alone
Plan_ThreeSubjects_OneExhausted_SkipsCorrectly: Math=2, Physics=1, Chem=2 → Physics exhausts early, cycle skips it
Plan_OrderPreserved_FromQueueKeys: order of cycling equals insertion order of Dictionary keys (captured at construction)

name: LargestQueueFirstSelector
tests:
Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue → no placements
Plan_SingleSubject_AlwaysPicked: one subject with count N → all N placements pick that subject
Plan_TwoSubjects_DifferentCounts_PicksLarger: Math=5, Physics=2 → always picks Math first since it has larger remaining count
Plan_TwoSubjects_EqualCounts_TieBreak: Math=3, Physics=3 → MaxBy returns last element with max value (Physics if Physics appears second in iteration)
Plan_MultipleSubjects_CountsDecrease_OrderedByRemaining: Math=3, Physics=5, Chem=1 → picks Physics→Math→... as counts change after each placement

name: SmallestQueueFirstSelector
tests:
Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue → no placements
Plan_SingleSubject_AlwaysPicked: one subject with count N → all N placements pick that subject
Plan_TwoSubjects_DifferentCounts_PicksSmaller: Math=5, Physics=2 → always picks Physics first since it has smaller remaining count
Plan_TwoSubjects_EqualCounts_TieBreak: Math=3, Physics=3 → MinBy returns last element with min value (Physics if Physics appears second)
Plan_MultipleSubjects_CountsChange_OrderedByRemaining: Math=3, Physics=1, Chem=2 → picks Physics→Chem→Math→... as counts equalize after decrements

name: LeadingChunkGrowthSelector
tests:
Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue → no placements
Plan_NoDaysWithRoomBeforeFirstChunk_YieldsNothing: all first chunks start at slot 1 (no room before them) → no placements
Plan_SingleDay_FirstChunkHasRoom_GrowsBackwards: single day, first chunk starts at slot 3 → places in slot 2, then slot 1
Plan_MultipleDays_SmallestFirstChunkChosenFirst: two days, day1 first chunk length=2, day2 first chunk length=1 → picks day2 first (smaller chunk)
Plan_DayWithRoom_MultiplePlacements_FillsTowardStart: single day with room for 3 slots before first chunk → places 3 times, filling slots backwards (2→1 or 4→3→2 depending on chunk position)
Plan_MultipleSubjects_RoundRobinPick: multiple subjects → subject order follows RoundRobinPicker
Plan_AllDaysFilled_StopsWhenNoRoom: after filling all room, subsequent TakeSlot returns null → Plan stops
Plan_EmptyDaysSkipped: days with no occupied slots (first chunk is null) are skipped and not enqueued

name: TrailingChunkGrowthSelector
tests:
Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue → no placements
Plan_NoDaysWithRoomAfterLastChunk_YieldsNothing: all last chunks end at slotCount (no room after them) → no placements
Plan_SingleDay_LastChunkHasRoom_GrowsForward: single day, last chunk ends at slot 4, slotCount=6 → places in slot 5, then slot 6
Plan_MultipleDays_SmallestLastChunkChosenFirst: two days, day1 last chunk length=2, day2 last chunk length=1 → picks day2 first (smaller chunk)
Plan_DayWithRoom_MultiplePlacements_FillsTowardEnd: single day with room for 2 slots after last chunk → fills slot by slot toward end
Plan_MultipleSubjects_RoundRobinPick: multiple subjects → subject order follows RoundRobinPicker
Plan_AllDaysFilled_StopsWhenNoRoom: after all trailing room consumed, TakeSlot returns null
Plan_CustomSlotCount_LastChunkEndComparedCorrectly: slotCount=10, last chunk ends at 8, room exists → places in slot 9, then slot 10

name: WeightedRandomSelector
tests:
Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue → no placements
Plan_SingleSubject_AlwaysPicked: one subject with count N → all N placements pick that subject
Plan_TwoSubjects_EqualCounts_SeededRandom_Deterministic: two subjects with equal weights, seeded Random(42) → same sequence every time
Plan_TwoSubjects_UnequalCounts_WeightedDistribution: Math=4, Physics=1 → with seeded Random, Physics has ~20% chance, Math ~80%, verify deterministic output matches expected sequence
Plan_QueueExhausted_Stops: queue subjects all placed → Plan stops when no more subjects available
Plan_SeededRandom_DeterministicSequence: multiple subjects with different weights, seeded Random → full deterministic sequence verified against expected order
